notes: «فسألناها فقالت قال» makes the umm walad the one asked who answers with the saying (rule 5), so she is the last link as relation
Abu Musa's own words («أما بلغك ما قال رسول الله») also quote the Prophet; the reading takes the umm walad as the relay of the saying, as her answer is the saying itself
«فسألناها» has an unnamed asker («نحن»), not a link
